name: fastmcp-engineering
description: Production engineering skills and verification workflows for building FastMCP MCP servers.

interface.shortDescription: Engineer, test, and verify production-grade MCP servers.
interface.longDescription: A skills-only engineering toolkit for designing, implementing, testing, securing, and reviewing production-grade MCP servers with FastMCP. It emphasizes official-documentation research, explicit architecture decisions, contracts, TDD, protocol conformance, security review, and evidence-based verification.
defaultPrompt: Design a production-grade FastMCP server for this requirement.
Review this MCP architecture and identify risks and missing contracts.
Build a verification plan for this FastMCP implementation.
